_doc: Detectability-conditioned relabelling of GULLS/RMDC26 with BinML's OWN label policy.

selection.rule: first 1600 scored 1S1L and first 2500 scored 1S2L / 2S2L event ids (dense, in id order) of rows_full_fspl5s_g08.json

policy.sigma: GULLS flux_err_uJy converted to magnitudes at the true flux
policy.baseline: median true-flux magnitude at |t-t0| > 5 tE over the full mission, per band
policy.single_lenses: never NonPSPL (training rule); pspl_refit_anomaly kept as a diagnostic
